_readme: The roster pi-small serves. See README.md. Field meanings mirror coding-bench/models.conf: repo is a Hugging Face repo id (llama-server downloads it with -hf/-hff), or the literal 'local' in which case 'file' is a path on the serving machine. 'localFile' is a copy already on the serving machine and wins when it resolves (it may use ~ and a * segment). It does NOT save a download -- this llama.cpp build caches -hf models in the Hugging Face hub layout and reuses them -- it skips the HF API round-trip and pins the run to the exact snapshot on disk, so a re-uploaded third-party quant cannot swap the weights mid-experiment. See README.md 'Where the weights actually live'. 'serverArgs' are extra llama-server flags for THIS model only -- that is where a model's tool-call template correction goes.

models.notes: No official Q6_K; third-party build. Round 3' PKG 6/6, probed response headers 3/3. Its embedded template carries a working tool-call channel — no override needed.
Official IBM GGUF. Best algorithm column of round 3', cheapest cells, but the 3B skips IBM's agentic-RL block — thin on verification. Embedded template handles tools.
No official GGUF. Slowest of the three (~3073s/cell in round 3').
